messages:
Aisha: Quick debrief from the SI Cadet cohort pilot — thanks everyone who joined the retro earlier. Wanted to capture outstanding asks and owners here. TL;DR: training content mostly good, hardware voucher flow needs simplification, and we should lock a marketplace onboarding checklist.

Marta: Loved the hands-on labs. Two quick points: 1) the step where trainees configure the KV cache felt rushed — need a 10-min deep dive + a short slide. 2) certification exam had a config question that referenced old CLI flags (we should update).

Dan: Noted on the KV cache dive, will prep a 10-min lab writeup. On vouchers: current redemption uses a long manual form. Can we generate single-use codes that map to a VM image? That reduces ops.

Leo: For voucher single-use codes we can mint short-lived tokens tied to GCP Marketplace entitlements. I prototyped an endpoint: 
```
POST /partner/v1/vouchers {
  "si_id": "si-123",
  "expires_in": 86400
}
```
It returns a code you can redeem via the marketplace UI. Need product sign-off on entitlement mapping though.

Tara: Marketplace checklist: list of items we need for a partner listing + marketing assets + legal. Also want to schedule a soft joint announcement once 3 SIs finish certification. Can we aim for cohort 2 completion by May 10? @Aisha thoughts on announcement timing? :calendar:

Aisha: May 10 target is fine if we batch cohort 2 start next week. Action items: Marta -> update cert exam questions (due 4/20); Dan -> voucher flow spec (4/15); Leo -> hook up token prototype to staging marketplace (4/18); Tara -> draft announcement cadence & assets list (4/22). I'll coordinate with security for KMS binding for voucher tokens.

Marta: Question on the cert: do we issue a digital badge immediately or after a manual QA review? My vote: auto-badge for passing score, then flagged for QA sampling. Reduces delay.

onboarding-bot: Marta passed cohort-1-hands-on (score: 88) — badge issued: "Redwood SI Cadet - Hands-on" :tada:

Dan: Auto-badge makes sense. We'll add a backend audit log entry and a weekly QA pass to sample 10%.

Leo: Small infra note: need a short-lived staging kube namespace per cadet for isolation. Should be in the voucher flow spec as an option.

Tara: For co-marketing, I'd like a one-pager with outcomes and an SI quote + logo permissions form. I'll ping legal for a standard release template.

Aisha: Great — I'll create a checklist doc and share the link later today. One more ask: can we add a 'trouble with hardware access' quick escalation channel (ops@redwood + on-call HW partner rep)? If yes, Dan/Leo can you add that to the voucher flow doc?

Dan: Yes, will add escalation contact and a small runbook snippet (fast repro steps, contact template).

Leo: I'll update the staging infra doc and include the namespace cleanup job (TTL 2h).

Aisha: Perfect. If there are no objections I'll convert these action items into Asana tasks and tag owners. Thanks all! :thumbsup:
